77248.subject: Weekly Recap: Self-Custody's Worst Week
77248.body:
**gm, Defiers!**

Self-custody had its worst week in memory. A firmware bug that shipped in 2021 made **Coldcard** seeds guessable, and attackers drained about $114 million from wallets whose owners had followed every best practice, then **BTCPay Server** operators closed the week racing a live exploit that swept Lightning nodes.

In Washington, the **CLARITY Act** slid toward 2027 after the Senate skipped a key filing, and **Ethereum** spent the week fighting over a proposal to burn validator rewards.

Enjoy!

———————————————————————————

———————————————————————————

# Top Stories This Week

## Coldcard Thefts Near $114 Million as Attackers Sweep Wallets That Did Everything Right

A March 2021 firmware change routed **Coldcard**'s seed generation to a predictable software randomizer, and five years later attackers [drained roughly $114 million across four waves](https://thedefiant.io/news/security/coldcard-thefts-near-usd114-million-as-fourth-attack-wave-hits) — about 1,816 BTC from more than 5,200 addresses. Victims [recounted losing life savings from air-gapped devices and safety deposit boxes](https://thedefiant.io/news/hacks/i-did-everything-right-coldcard-victims-recount-losing-life-savings): one watched 18.25 BTC vanish in seven minutes. Maker **Coinkite** halted shipments, destroyed affected stock, and shipped emergency firmware for every model; the fourth wave opted into replace-by-fee, giving alert victims a brief window to outbid the thief in the mempool.

## Lightning Nodes Drained as BTCPay Server Users Race to Patch

**BTCPay Server** told operators to [install version 2.4.2 or turn their servers off](https://thedefiant.io/news/hacks/btcpay-server-tells-operators-to-update-or-shut-down-over-actively-exploited-flaw) as a critical vulnerability was exploited in the wild — hardware wallet maker **Foundation** and the Bitcoin zine **Citadel21** said their nodes were swept, in some cases hours before the public alert. Days earlier, non-custodial bridge [Boltz halted swaps indefinitely](https://thedefiant.io/news/hacks/bitcoin-bridge-boltz-halts-swaps-indefinitely-citing-ai-assisted-attacks), saying months of AI-assisted attacks now iterate faster than its team can patch.

## Ethereum Weighs Burning Validator Rewards to Cap Staking

A new proposal, [EIP-8361, would deduct a rising share of every validator's rewards](https://thedefiant.io/news/blockchains/eip-8361-tapered-issuance-burn-ethereum-staking-yield) as the staking ratio climbs, cancelling consensus issuance outright at 50% staked. **Aave**'s Stani Kulechov and **ether.fi**'s Mike Silagadze led two days of opposition, and [SharpLink's Joseph Chalom warned](https://thedefiant.io/news/blockchains/sharplink-opposes-ethereum-proposal-to-burn-a-growing-share-of-validator-rewards) the draft would strip the base rate out from under roughly $35 billion in liquid staking collateral and could push institutions to sell ETH as they unstake.

77223.subject: Online check-in for a smooth take-off. ATTENTION! Don’t forget – it opens 24 hours before departure. (Y9SB5U)
77223.body:
Hello, Oleh Novosadov!

Your adventure is just around the corner – you’ll soon be boarding your Ryanair flight! There’s just one small step left to ensure a smooth start: online check-in.

It’s easy – do it via the Ryanair app. This way, you avoid unnecessary fees at the airport..

How to do it? Here’s a quick guide:

You will need:
- Booking code: Y9SB5U
- Booking email: novosadov@boarding.sk (it may differ from your personal email address)

If you’re using the Ryanair mobile app, you can check in directly there – it’s fast, convenient and eco-friendly.

When is check-in available?
- From 24 to 2 hours before departure
- If you’ve purchased seats, you can check in as early as 60 days before your flight

Download your boarding passes.

Save them in the app – you’ll need them when going through airport security. Before your trip, make sure your BOARDING PASSES (tickets) are in ELECTRONIC FORM. Download them to your phone.

You’ll find a full step-by-step guide with screenshots in our manual for checking in online via the Ryanair app.

ATTENTION! If you leave the check-in until the airport, it may cost you up to €55.

That’s a lot of money you could use for your next Pelikan adventure instead! Check our calendar of promotional flights and start planning your next trip right now!
